final: SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_order_counts, AVG(account_share) AS average_share, AVG(account_share - average_share) AS average_share_difference FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS account_share, (SELECT AVG(CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order")) FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id)) AS average_share FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") > (SELECT AVG(CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order")) FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id)))
